Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Sanjay - 33 years, prince, son
Look: golden crown, red royal robe
2. Sunita - 59 years, queen, mother
Look: golden jewellery, green royal dress
3. Hema - 26 years, princess, daughter
Look: small crown, pink lehenga
4. Vikram - 44 years, general
Look: iron armour, red turban
5. Anjali - 29 years, friend
Look: red salwar-kameez

Places

1. The battlefield - tents, flags, dust

Scene 1: The battlefield - Day

[Sanjay stands on the battlefield. Sunita, Hema and Vikram stand near him.]

Hema: "Let's do something fun today."

[A sword slashes Sanjay's arm and blood runs down to his wrist.]

Sunita: "Hey, look at that!"

[Wounded, Sanjay staggers and drops to one knee.]

Sunita: "Show me too!"

[Sanjay breathes his last as Mother holds his hand.]

Hema: "No… this cannot be!"
